narration: Here's something nobody tells you — most people don't choose when they retire. Half of all retirees are pushed out before they planned.
visual: Dark background. Person silhouette at a desk with a calendar showing '65'. Text: 'YOU THINK YOU CONTROL WHEN YOU RETIRE'. A red strikethrough line slashes across the text, followed by the word 'WRONG.' appearing in red.

narration: The Employee Benefit Research Institute tracked it. Fifty percent retire involuntarily — layoffs, health problems, family emergencies. The average forced exit hits three years early.
visual: Light background. Ten stick figure icons in two rows of five. The top five glow amber — representing the 50% forced out. The bottom five are gray. Large stat text: '50% RETIRE INVOLUNTARILY — AVG 3 YEARS EARLY'.

narration: Number one cost: Social Security. Claiming at sixty-two instead of sixty-seven permanently cuts your check by thirty percent — every single month, for the rest of your life.
visual: Dark background. SVG Social Security card showing $1,800/month. Then a red '-30%' spring-in animation, with text: 'EARLY CLAIM PENALTY — EVERY MONTH · FOREVER. $1,800 → $1,260/mo'.

narration: Number two: three fewer years of savings compounding at seven percent adds up to over a hundred and forty thousand dollars in lost investment growth alone.
visual: Light background. Animated piggy bank SVG with an amber coin dropping in the slot. Two growing bar chart columns side by side — amber bar labeled PLANNED taller than red bar labeled FORCED. Stat: '-$140K IN GROWTH'.

narration: Add those two hits together over a twenty-year retirement and you're looking at three hundred and twelve thousand dollars — that's the real price tag of an unplanned early exit.
visual: Dark background. Two horizontal bars growing: 'LOST SS INCOME $172K' in red and 'LOST INVESTMENT GROWTH $140K' in amber. Then a large white '$312K' springs in with label: 'TOTAL FORCED RETIREMENT COST'.

narration: The fix: build a bridge fund — two years of expenses in cash. That way you control when you claim Social Security, even when you can't control when you stop working.
visual: Light background. A savings jar SVG filling up with green liquid. Label on jar: 'BRIDGE FUND'. Text overlay: '2 YEARS OF EXPENSES IN CASH = POWER OVER TIMING'. Bottom text: 'PLAN FOR 62 · HOPE FOR 67'.
